blogs.title: Don't Break What Works: Why Preserving Neuron Angles Makes AI Art Better
blogs.description: This post demystifies the core innovation behind Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT). Instead of focusing on complex math, we'll explore the intuitive idea that an AI artist's 'style' and 'knowledge' are stored in the *angles* between its internal neurons, not just their raw values. Learn how OFT rotates these neurons to adapt to new tasks (like drawing a specific pet) without destroying the fundamental artistic ability learned during pre-training.

blogs.title: DreamBooth vs. OFT: Solving the Stability Crisis in Custom AI Models
blogs.description: Have you ever tried to teach an AI to draw your dog, only for it to turn your pet into a fuzzy blob after too many training steps? This blog tackles the common problem of 'model collapse' in subject-driven generation. We'll compare traditional methods like DreamBooth and LoRA against the new Orthogonal Finetuning approach, highlighting how OFT offers lightning-fast convergence and rock-solid stability even with limited data.

blogs.title: Beyond Prompts: Mastering Precise Control with Orthogonal Finetuning
blogs.description: Text prompts are great, but sometimes you need precise control—like telling an AI to match a specific sketch outline or segmentation map exactly. Discover how OFT empowers controllable generation tasks (like turning edge maps into photos) more efficiently than existing tools like ControlNet. We'll break down why this method requires fewer parameters, runs faster during inference, and delivers sharper, more accurate results.
